scene: The dial shifts the winds, summoning three strange transports along the ridge.
picture: A flat side view along the breezy ridge. Far left, a red sleigh tram sits on frosty tracks. Centre-left, the boy in his orange vest and kite stands beside the brass dial. Right, a glass-bottomed canal boat floats in a water lock. Far right, a large striped hot-air balloon sways gently, tethered to a post.
shown: a frosty red sleigh tram resting on frozen rails on the far left
a glass-bottomed canal boat tethered to a stone canal lock on the right
a striped hot-air balloon moored to a wooden post on the far right
